sections.heading: New Design Direction
paragraphs: According to Giga, Xiaomi is going completely new ways with a smartphone that has reportedly never been seen before.

sections.heading: Hardware Specifications
paragraphs: Notebookcheck reports that Xiaomi is 'perfecting' a flagship device. According to a hands-on report cited by the source, the device features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, an 185Hz Super Pixel Display, and D2 graphics.

sections.heading: Leaked Details and Variants
paragraphs: China-Gadgets discussed the Redmi K100 Pro Max in a podcast. According to the source, the device will be available in an upcoming iPhone color. The podcast also covered leaks regarding the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max and a Google Pixel Tag.
